payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_spec_review.py::test_a_writer_session_names_the_fault_lines_its_returned_text_still_carries stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/spec_review.py. The claim was "`SpecWriterSession` gains a field `fault_lines`, a tuple of strings that defaults to empty. `run_spec_writer` sets it to the lines `faults` last returned for the session's own `text`, once the send-backs ran out or the session gave up. The witness drives six sessions. A clean first draft and a send-back that comes back clean leave it empty. A send-back still faulted carries the second judgement's lines, which differ from the first's. A send-back that does not parse leaves the first text standing, with the first judgement's lines. When neither text parses, the newest text carries its own lines. A send-back whose work turn raises ends in `_give_up`, and its session carries the lines of the text it returns.".
